entities.name: Gonzalo Fernández de la Mora
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Gonzalo Fernández de la Mora y Mon was a Spanish essayist and politician who represented Pontevedra in Congress for the Popular Alliance from 1977 to 1979. He was married to Isabel Valera Una, and had four children with her: Isabel, Gonzalo, Juan Luis and Sandra.
